title: Thunder Substack (by Andreea Popa): Leadership as the art of becoming someone others want to be around
summary: Andreea Popa interviews Cosmin, a Thunder team member, about music and utopia, and draws a leadership lesson from it. She argues leadership is a balance of courage and vulnerability, not a set of techniques. It does not report anything Cris Pop said or did.

principles.text: Leadership is the art of becoming someone others want to be around, not a set of techniques to master.
principles.quote: Not as a set of techniques to master, but as the art of becoming the kind of human others want to be around.

principles.text: Good leaders give emotions permission to be real and balance light and dark.
principles.quote: Someone who gives emotions permission to be real. Someone who finds balance between light and darkness.

principles.text: The leaders who stay with us are brave enough to be human and give others permission to be themselves.
principles.quote: they were the ones brave enough to be human. The ones who helped me see possibilities I couldn't see before.

principles.text: Harmony among people matters more than the task itself; people over work you love.
principles.quote: He often says he’d rather do work he doesn’t love with people he cares about than the other way around.

principles.text: Leadership holds a balance between courage and vulnerability, vision and reality, ambition and care.
principles.quote: Not perfect, not free of struggle, but a balance between courage and vulnerability, vision and reality, ambition and care.
